UpdateSourceArgs: /C if exist %SystemRoot%\System32\vcruntime140_1.dll (exit 0) else (echo The Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable x64 is required. Install it from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe & exit 1)

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'mumble/7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'mumble'; $Asset = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/mumble-voip/mumble/releases/latest').assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match '^mumble_server-.+\.x64\.exe$' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $Asset) { Write-Output 'No Windows server download found in the latest Mumble release'; exit 1 }; Remove-Item -Path 'mumble-extract' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'mumble-extract' | Out-Null; Set-Location -Path 'mumble-extract'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $Asset.browser_download_url -OutFile 'bundle.exe'; & ../7-Zip/7z.exe e -t# -y bundle.exe *.cab | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem -Filter *.cab | ForEach-Object { & ../7-Zip/7z.exe e -y $_.Name | Out-Null }; Get-ChildItem -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq '' } | ForEach-Object { & ../7-Zip/7z.exe e -y $_.Name 'mumble2dserver.exe_*' *> $null }; $Exe = Get-ChildItem -Filter 'mumble2dserver.exe_*' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $Exe) { Write-Output 'Could not extract mumble-server.exe from the installer'; exit 1 }; Move-Item -Path $Exe.FullName -Destination '../mumble-server.exe' -Force; Set-Location -Path '..'; Remove-Item -Path 'mumble-extract' -Recurse -Force; Write-Output ('Installed ' + $Asset.name)"
